name: The Sexy Tunes Show
source:
Where's Bugs? It's bunny season! And Lola needs to satisfy her sexual desire, so she'll have to search for him all over town. No matter who she has to fight (or sleep with), she has to find Bugs! Interacting with others is key!

[From [url=https://theintroverti2.itch.io/the-sexy-tunes-show]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
兔八哥上哪儿去了？眼下正是兔子的发情季！欲火难耐的萝拉急需得到满足，为此她不得不翻遍整座小镇寻找兔八哥的踪迹。无论路上要和谁大打出手（或是滚上床单），她都誓要找到兔八哥！与他人互动正是破局的关键！

[摘自[url=https://theintroverti2.itch.io/the-sexy-tunes-show]itch.io[/url]]
